# [Updated] Possible changes for Patch 45 on July 18, 2023

![](/uploads/ajaxGallery_188_nukaknights-post-patch45-possible-changes.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

Note July 18, 2023: None of the relevant changes (apart from the new plans for Grahm and Fleischwoche) from the PTS were released today, everything looks like patch 46. See: Fallout 76 - Patch notes July 18, 2023 (Patch 45)

[Update July 18, 2023] Changed Grenadier Perk Test Youtube Video, Peng Fu Perk

[Update July 16, 2023] New PTS data mining, new Fallout 1st tent

[Update July 15, 2023] New screenshots, freezer info, weapon carrier + WWR info (incl. YT video), scientist screenshot, scientist test video, fast travel fix

The next update awaits us on **July 18, 2023** with some minor changes and little content. Unfortunately, the last PTS was only online for a short time and couldn't be played with our main characters, but you could see a few things in the game files. Some of the changes may come into play next week. Some may not be available until Patch 46 with the next season. We'll see exactly what will be published on Tuesday.

## New setups for new players

New players can now choose when leaving the vault whether they want to start at level 1, or whether they want to start at level 20 with a basic build and appropriate equipment.

### Youtube video:

![New setups for new players and level boost to level 20](/uploads/nukaknights-pts-patch45-new-player-setups.jpg)

A new **donation box** awaits players in front of the vault, which can also be used by other players to give something to newcomers.

## Patch notes changes

- There are now level 10 versions of the T-45 and Raider Power armor
- There is a new filter for new perk cards
- Below level 50, players will now receive a warning when attempting to join a daily operation.
- All workbench lists use alphabetical sorting.
- Item names in the workbench are standardized across all lists.
- The "Show Unlockables" button now displays recipes that you can learn through a plan, through scrapping, or purchase from the Atomic Shop.
- Unlearned recipes will display the name of the plan you need, the item you need to scrap, or allow purchase from the Atom Shop.
- 1-star Legendary Mods will no longer appear under “Random Legendary Mods”. 2 and 3 star mods are now correctly displayed under “Current Mods” when examining an item.
- The learned mod counter has been improved.

## Patch notes design changes

- We have lowered the level requirements for various perk cards.
- Added more standard CAMP recipes for all players.
- The fight in Morgantown and Summerville has been rebalanced.
- The Liberator Bots outside of Vault 76 have been replaced by Ghouls.
- The frequency of enemy attacks on the player's CAMP has been reduced
- Adjusted the Gun Fu perk effect and text description.
- The beetles have been eradicated and the mysterious construction of the Gilman Lumber Mill has begun.
- Renamed over 600 CAMP items.
- The Hunter/Hunted radio station and event have been removed.
- The description of “A Poem with Salt” accurately reflects the impact of the change. The Refrigerated mod cannot be combined with the perk.
- The Grenadier perk now applies to Gauss weapons.
- Players will no longer receive legendary power armor pieces as rewards for events and quests up to level 20.
- Legendary creatures no longer mutate at 50% health to gain health regeneration, but instead have increased health by 60%.
- Various changes to health, resistances and weapon damage for the following creatures: Super Mutant, Protectron, Mole Rat, Mr.Handy/Gutsy, Feral Ghoul, Scorched, Glowing
